annotations.title: One agreement record by its SHA-256

description: Return one agreement record as the ledger stores it, by its canonical SHA-256: the exact record bytes, pending or anchored, and the ledger entry once anchored. The anchored agreements of an endpoint are listed in agreements[] of its Résumé (nenrin_resume).

sha256.description: 64-hex canonical SHA-256 of the agreement record

name: nenrin_agreement

lookup.description: ok = the ledger was read and the record exists. absent = the ledger was read and there is no such record. A read that FAILED never appears here: it comes back as a tool error (isError: true), so a consumer can never mistake this server's own failure for a statement about the ledger's contents.

source_url.description: The public ledger URL that returned this body. Fetch it yourself to compare.
